entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: So there're a total of three areas...[n]What a pain in the butt.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: It's way too early to give up though. We[n]haven't even reached the first area yet.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Seriously...? Ugh, I swear I'm gonna die[n]in here.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
